title: Shared definitions for docs.export.v1
description: DRAFT, mock-only (Demo Doc). Not frozen until the Lead freezes it. Additive changes only once frozen. id, timestamp, idempotencyKey are byte-identical to syllabus.v1 (a contract test should enforce it). Nothing here can carry a token, a Google URL other than the one allowlisted docs.google.com document form, transcript text or a segment id.

id.description: Opaque server-assigned id, one canonical form (see syllabus-common id). Prefixes used here: dxp_ (export), ddc_ (Demo Doc). Clients must not parse ids.

sessionId.description: Lecture session id: canonical lowercase hyphenated GUID (Guid.ToString D), the form lecture routes bind as {id:guid}. Upper case, braces and urn forms are 400 before any lookup (DXD-12).

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency-Key header value: 8-128 URL-safe characters, no trailing newline. Anything else is 400 validation_failed.

notesId.description: Id of the notes press being exported (lecture.v1 notes.notesId). The server reads the stored notes by this id for the authenticated user; the client never sends notes text.

contentDigest.description: Opaque. 'cd_' + first 43 chars of base64url(HMAC-SHA-256(K, label LF sessionId LF canonical JSON of {v:1, notesId, title, blocks})). K is derived by HKDF from the root secret with the NEW label docs-content-digest.v1 (add it to DerivedKeys.Labels); the idempotency and audit keys are never reused; label is the literal docs-content-digest.v1. Canonical JSON: UTF-8, no whitespace, members in the order the schemas list them, strings NFC with only the quote, backslash and u00XX control escapes, integers in decimal. HMAC, never a plain hash. An equality check on content only, never proof of authorization. A root-secret rotation makes stored digests stale (upToDate turns false once; accepted).

provider.description: demo_docs only in v1. Widening this enum to add google_docs is the single wire change a real provider needs (ADR section 9); it is NOT authorised and NOT built.

docTitle.description: One line of untrusted plain text, 1-200 code points, no control, bidi-override or zero-width characters (server TextPolicy; the schema only forbids C0, DEL, NEL, LS, PS).

blockText.description: One line of untrusted plain text, 1-500 code points. Rendered as text only: never HTML, Markdown or a link.

citation.description: A time in the lecture only. No segmentId and no transcript text leave the app (same rule as the Markdown export, item 2).

document.description: What would be (preview) or was (Demo Doc) written. Max 400 blocks. Over the cap the preview says canWrite=false/too_large; blocks are never silently dropped.

docRef.description: Where the document is. in_app (Demo Doc): openPath is an app route, openUrl null. external (reserved for a real provider, never emitted by the demo): openUrl is the allowlisted docs.google.com document form, openPath null. version starts at 1 and bumps on every update.

mode.description: create: no document exists for this lecture yet. update: replace the content of the document this app made for this lecture (version+1). create_another: leave the earlier document alone and make a second one. The server only accepts the modes the latest preview listed in actions.

errorCode.description: ProblemDetails codes. lecture.v1 codes keep their meaning. Docs additions: too_large (413 body cap), retry_limit_reached (409). export_in_progress (409) is RESERVED for a real provider: the demo write is one transaction serialised by an advisory lock, so the demo never emits it.

recordErrorCode.description: Why an attempt failed, carried inside a 200 record. Emitted by the demo: provider_unavailable, rate_limited, provider_rejected. RESERVED for a real provider, never emitted by the demo (listed now so adding them is not a wire change): reconnect_required, doc_changed_outside, quota_exceeded.
